title: Optimism Cross Chain - Open App
meta_description: optimism cross chain access for the official OP Mainnet bridge app, built for supported Ethereum and OP Mainnet asset transfers.
hero_h2: Move Assets Between Ethereum and OP Mainnet
hero_lead: Optimism Cross Chain routes users to the official OP Mainnet Gateway for supported ETH and ERC-20 transfers between Ethereum and OP Mainnet.
what_is: Optimism is the ecosystem behind OP Mainnet, its flagship Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain; the official bridge routes supported transfers between Ethereum and OP Mainnet through app.optimism.io.

how.d: Use the official app URL and verify the app.optimism.io domain before connecting a wallet.
Select your Ethereum wallet and confirm you are on the intended source network.
Pick the supported token, amount, source chain, and OP Mainnet destination.
Check gas, recipient, timing, and token details before signing the transaction.

points.p: The destination should be the Optimism bridge interface on app.optimism.io, not a lookalike domain.
Optimism docs describe the Standard Bridge as supporting ETH and most ERC-20 transfers between Ethereum and OP Mainnet.
OP Mainnet is an Ethereum Layer 2; ethereum.org explains how Layer 2 networks extend Ethereum while relying on its base layer.

faq.q: What is optimism cross chain used for?
faq.a: It is used to find the official Optimism bridge path for moving supported assets between Ethereum and OP Mainnet.

faq.q: Is optimism cross chain the official bridge?
faq.a: This landing page is not the official app; the official action happens at app.optimism.io.

faq.q: How long does optimism cross chain bridging take?
faq.a: Optimism docs state Ethereum-to-OP Mainnet Standard Bridge transfers usually complete in 1-3 minutes, while OP Mainnet-to-Ethereum withdrawals complete after the 7-day challenge period.

faq.q: Which assets can optimism cross chain route?
faq.a: The Standard Bridge supports ETH and most ERC-20 tokens, but availability depends on the selected token, bridge route, and token representation.

faq.q: Can optimism cross chain send assets back to Ethereum?
faq.a: Yes, supported assets can be withdrawn from OP Mainnet to Ethereum, but users should review the longer withdrawal timing and required confirmations before signing.

footer_note: This page is not the official Optimism app; verify app.optimism.io before connecting, and treat all content as educational, not financial advice.
